controls.positive: same exact identity and admitted fact set remain accepted and reproducible
controls.fixed: a changed fixed source/blob/region identity is rejected or assigned a new identity
controls.safe: safe-like fixtures remain candidate/unassessed and cannot be inferred from absence or partial coverage
controls.unrelated: unrelated findings and files retain their independent identity and are not merged into the target region
controls.unknown: missing or conflicting repository/tree/blob/build/dependency/parse/budget facts remain unknown and fail closed
